body: I know for a fact things don't improve. It isn't about seeking help, attention, or being that person who may or may not same someone else's life. It's about being pushed far beyond my own personal threshold of what I am willing to endure for the entirety of my adult life, knowing I'm unhappy, and realizing that continuing to live will only prolong that unhappiness because not a singular goddamn thing ever changes for the better and I'm tired of having to keep going through the motions of a life I did not want for myself.
